facts.text: I am tasked with creating a social media post generator that can generate Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram posts based on a user-provided topic and relevant keywords.
I am tasked with designing a generator that can create hashtags for each platform.
I need the generator to take input from the user on the topic and relevant keywords.
I need the generator to generate a post for each platform (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram) that incorporates the input provided by the user.
I need the generator to create hashtags for each post that are relevant to the platform and the input provided by the user.
I need 15 hashtags for Facebook.
I need 15 hashtags for Instagram.
I need 5 hashtags for Twitter.
I need 15 hashtags for LinkedIn.
Acta Finance is developing its ecosystem minimum viable product (MVP) and recently started marketing its products on the Avalanche testnet.
Acta Finance empowers individuals and organizations to vote for their financial future.
Acta Finance has a people-first mindset and a philosophy called “Acta Non Verba (Acts Not Words)”.

Acta Finance is building a decentralized financial protocol that introduces many centralized features on-chain for the first time to combat manipulation, corruption, and abuse of passive earning features.
Acta Finance aims to help users optimize their financial strategy, make informed decisions, and achieve long-term goals.

Acta Finance offers products including ActaFi staking, ActaFi farming, ActaFi wNFTs, ActaFi referral program, ActaFi address milestones, ActaFi swap, ActaFi liquidity aggregator, and the ActaFi DAO program.
Acta Finance’s products have been completed and audited and are available on the ActaFi testnet.
Acta Finance is the first project utilizing a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) to decide whether it should go to market.
On Feb. 6, 2023, Acta Finance launched its first ever DAO vote about whether Acta Finance’s native (ACTA) token would go to market at the end of Q1, 2023.
The DAO vote closed on Feb. 22 with an 80.95% vote in favor of going to market.
Acta Finance launched a “Grow The ActaFam” engagement airdrop competition on Crew3.
The “Grow The ActaFam” competition features a go-to-market rewards pool of 292,500 ACTA.
The “Grow The ActaFam” competition started Monday, Feb. 27, 2023.
The go-to-market round one duration is Feb. 27, 12:00 am ET–May 1, 11:59 pm ET.
The “Grow The ActaFam” exclusive go-to-market round one rewards pool is valued at $39,487 USDT.
The monthly rewards are 0.05% of the total token supply (97,500 ACTA).
Acta Finance’s initial dex offerings are scheduled for near the end of March and into April.
Acta Finance is consulting Paid Ignition and Avata Network to determine appropriate ticket size revisions to ensure a successful fundraiser before launching on Avalanche.
Acta Finance’s fundraiser launch dates on Avalanche are listed as exact dates TBA.
Acta Finance’s Crew3 questboard is at https://crew3.xyz/c/actafi/questboard.
Acta Finance’s token generation event (TGE) is referenced as an upcoming milestone.
